prompt: Add two permalink tokens based on the front matter date: `:isoyear`, the ISO 8601 year as 4 digits, and `:isoweek`, the ISO 8601 week number zero-padded to 2 digits. Near the new year they differ from `:year` (2021-01-03 is week 53 of ISO year 2020). Make them usable in `[permalinks]` site config and document them next to the existing date tokens in the content-management docs. Keep the existing tests passing.
